edges.reason: _getNextTokenId reads _currentTokenId to compute the next token id
_incrementTokenId mutates _currentTokenId via unchecked ++
mintTo advances _currentTokenId through _getNextTokenId and _incrementTokenId
mintTo calls _getNextTokenId
mintTo calls _incrementTokenId
mintTo calls _mint for the new token id
mintTo is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
onlyOwner compares owner() derived from _owner with the caller
onlyOwner obtains the caller through _msgSender which is overridable
_msgSender delegates to ContextMixin.msgSender
ContextMixin.msgSender returns msg.sender when the caller is not the contract itself
msgSender uses inline assembly over msg.data when msg.sender == address(this)
executeMetaTransaction forwards msg.sender as the relayer address
executeMetaTransaction reads and increments nonces[userAddress]
executeMetaTransaction calls verify before executing the payload
executeMetaTransaction performs a low-level call back into the contract
the low-level self call can re-enter meta-transaction execution / contract functions
verify relies on EIP712 typed message hashing initialized by _initializeEIP712 state
_initializeEIP712 calls _setDomainSeperator
_setDomainSeperator writes domainSeperator
ERC721Tradable constructor calls _initializeEIP712
constructor assigns proxyRegistryAddress
Start721 constructor invokes the ERC721Tradable constructor
setBaseTokenURI is guarded by onlyOwner
setBaseTokenURI overwrites _baseTokenURI
baseTokenURI returns _baseTokenURI
tokenURI calls baseTokenURI
tokenURI encodes the _tokenId argument into the URI
isApprovedForAll queries proxyRegistryAddress for the owner's proxy
isApprovedForAll falls back to super (ERC721 _operatorApprovals)
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner variable
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner
renounceOwnership clears the privileged _owner variable
_mint increments _balances[to]
_mint assigns _owners[tokenId]
_transfer decrements and increments _balances
_transfer reassigns _owners[tokenId]
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after _mint
_checkOnERC721Received passes _msgSender() into the receiver hook
safe transfer invokes the receiver onERC721Received callback
the receiver callback can re-enter transfer/mint flow before completion
